name: Simple Combat and Soak Foundation
designRule: Combat uses one attack roll, one damage roll after a hit, one eligible soak roll, and Vitality loss. Firearm critical successes add damage dice; ordinary extra attack successes do not. Non-Lethal damage can be resisted by mortal Resilience, Lethal damage limits mortals to Armor, and Aggravated damage bypasses every ordinary soak procedure.

diceConventions.standardSuccess: A result of 6 through 10 is one success unless a rule says otherwise.
diceConventions.criticalSuccess: A result of 10 on the final attack roll is one critical success and also one ordinary success.
diceConventions.damageAndSoakTens: A 10 on a damage or soak roll is normally one success, not two successes and not an exploding die.
diceConventions.changedThreshold: The normal damage and soak success threshold is 6+. Change it only when an item, capability, hazard, or exceptional circumstance explicitly states another threshold.

coreProcedure.start: Combat begins when opposed actions become time-sensitive enough that acting first changes the result. Establish positions, cover, visible threats, current tracks, and immediate objectives before Initiative.
coreProcedure.initiative: Initiative equals Finesse + Composure. Act from highest Initiative to lowest. Break ties with higher Awareness, then higher Finesse, then one unmodified d10 roll.
coreProcedure.round: A round is approximately six seconds. Each participant receives one turn per round.
coreProcedure.turn: On a turn, take one Standard Action, move up to 8 meters, and perform one Minor Interaction in any order. A Standard Action may become another Move or Minor Interaction. Unused actions are lost.
coreProcedure.reaction: A character has one Reaction per round. It refreshes at the start of that character's turn and may be used only when a rule, capability, item, or Cohesion option allows it.

basicLoop: Build the attack pool from the printed Attribute and Skill.
Add one attack die for every Exposure point currently carried by the target.
Subtract attack dice for range, cover, conditions, and equipment.
Roll against Defense Difficulty, equal to ceiling(Guard / 2), minimum 1.
If the attack misses, stop. No damage roll or soak roll occurs.
If the attack hits, build and roll the damage pool. Firearms add one damage die for every critical success on the final attack roll. Other ordinary extra attack successes add nothing.

If the damage is Non-Lethal, Lethal, or Disruption, the defender builds and rolls every soak die legally granted by mortal Resilience, Armor, a printed supernatural soak ability, or another explicit capability.
Aggravated damage receives no ordinary soak roll. Apply only an ability that explicitly grants immunity, resistance, reduction, or protection against that exact Aggravated damage.
Each legal soak success cancels one damage success. Mark every uncancelled success as damage of the attack's type.
attackPools: Unarmed or forceful melee: Force + Close Combat.
Heavy weapon: Force + Heavy Weapons unless the item states otherwise.
Damaging capability: use the pool printed by the capability.
attackProcedure.firearmCriticals: Each final attack die showing 10 adds one die to the firearm's damage pool when the attack hits. A missed attack inflicts no damage regardless of critical successes. Replacement dice from a Push can generate critical successes; discarded original dice do not count.
cover: Total Cover: no direct attack unless an effect crosses or destroys it.
range: Beyond Long: unavailable unless explicitly allowed.

damageRolls.rule: A successful damaging attack rolls a damage pool. Every result of 6+ is one damage success before soak or explicit resistance.
damageRolls.unarmed: An ordinary unarmed strike rolls Force damage dice and normally deals Non-Lethal/Bashing damage.
damageRolls.weapons: A weapon rolls its printed Damage Dice. A melee weapon may explicitly add Force; if it does not say so, use only its printed pool.
damageRolls.firearms: A firearm rolls printed Damage Dice plus one die for every critical success on the final Firearms attack roll.
damageRolls.powers: A damaging capability rolls the pool or fixed damage dice printed by that capability.
damageRolls.noMargin: There is no Margin statistic. Noncritical attack successes beyond those required to hit do not add damage dice.

bashing.name: Non-Lethal / Bashing
bashing.meaning: Blunt force, punches, falls, fatigue, shock, restraint trauma, and impacts that bruise or batter without primarily cutting or destroying essential tissue. Bashing is the system's Non-Lethal damage category.
bashing.mortality: Non-Lethal/Bashing damage can incapacitate and can eventually kill, but mortal Resilience is allowed to resist it before damage is marked.

lethal.name: Lethal
lethal.meaning: Cutting, penetration, severe crushing, ordinary gunfire against living bodies, major falls, vehicle impact, and other injuries that tear or destroy essential tissue.
ordinaryExamples: Ordinary firearm against a living target
lethal.mortalRule: Mortals cannot use Resilience to soak Lethal damage. They may roll eligible Armor only.

aggravated.name: Aggravated
aggravated.meaning: Supernatural, cursed, consecrated, reality-destroying, or utterly decimating harm that bypasses ordinary toughness, Armor, Fortitude, Living Soak, and every generic soak procedure.
ordinaryExamples: Supernatural claws or teeth when the capability says Aggravated
aggravated.absoluteRule: Do not build a normal soak pool against Aggravated damage. Only an ability that explicitly names immunity, resistance, reduction, or protection against that exact Aggravated damage can alter it.

disruption.name: Disruption
disruption.meaning: Memory, identity, noospheric, continuity, and control-system damage. Disruption uses its own printed soak or resistance and is not Non-Lethal, Lethal, or Aggravated physical damage.

soakProcedure.meaning: Soak represents the ability to absorb, ignore, disperse, or remain functional through damage after the damage roll succeeds.
soakProcedure.timing: Roll soak after the damage roll and before marking Vitality loss, but only when the damage type and the character's recorded capabilities permit a soak roll.
soakProcedure.cancellation: Each soak success cancels one damage success. Soak cannot create healing or reduce damage below 0.
soakProcedure.mortalNonLethal: A mortal or human-adjacent character rolls Resilience + eligible Armor against Non-Lethal/Bashing damage.
soakProcedure.mortalLethal: A mortal or human-adjacent character rolls eligible Armor only against Lethal damage. Resilience cannot enter that soak pool.
soakProcedure.supernaturalSoak: A supernatural character uses the soak pool explicitly printed by its Archetype, form, power, item, or ability. Being supernatural by itself grants no universal soak dice. When no supernatural soak capability applies, use the ordinary mortal or human-adjacent permissions.
soakProcedure.aggravatedBypass: Aggravated damage bypasses Resilience, ordinary Armor, Fortitude, Living Soak, and generic supernatural soak. Apply only exact immunities or resistances printed by abilities.
soakProcedure.armor: Eligible Armor adds its Armor Rating as soak dice against Non-Lethal/Bashing or Lethal damage. Armor does not automatically subtract damage and never applies to Aggravated damage unless a specific ability explicitly converts that Armor into an exact Aggravated resistance.
soakProcedure.zeroDice: A target with no legal soak dice takes every damage success unless another explicit effect intervenes.
soakProcedure.oneRoll: Combine all legal dice into one soak pool and roll once for that damaging hit.

ordinaryMortalOrHumanAdjacent.bashing: Roll Resilience + eligible Armor against Non-Lethal/Bashing damage.
ordinaryMortalOrHumanAdjacent.lethal: Roll eligible Armor only. Ordinary biology does not add Resilience against Lethal damage.
ordinaryMortalOrHumanAdjacent.aggravated: No soak roll. Only an exact immunity or resistance explicitly naming the Aggravated damage can alter it.
ordinaryMortalOrHumanAdjacent.disruption: Roll Resolve plus explicit continuity, noospheric, or identity protection when the attack permits a soak roll.

supernaturalGeneral.rule: Use the supernatural soak procedure explicitly recorded by the character's Archetype, form, power, item, or ability. Supernatural status alone is not a defense.
supernaturalGeneral.withoutPrintedSoak: When no printed supernatural soak applies, use the ordinary mortal or human-adjacent permissions.
supernaturalGeneral.aggravated: No generic supernatural soak applies. Aggravated damage requires an exact immunity or resistance written for that damage or source.

vampire.fortitudeRating: Fortitude equals the highest rank the Vampire owns in the Deathless Resilience power family, from 0 to 5. Fortitude is added to permitted Vampire soak rolls against Non-Lethal/Bashing, Lethal, and Disruption damage. Fortitude does not soak Aggravated damage by itself.
vampire.bashing: Roll Resilience + eligible Armor + Fortitude. After soak, halve the remaining Non-Lethal/Bashing damage, rounding down.
vampire.lethal: Roll Resilience + eligible Armor + Fortitude. Take every damage success that remains after soak.
vampire.aggravated: No soak roll from Resilience, Armor, Fortitude, or Undead Soak. Apply only an exact Vampire ability that explicitly grants immunity or resistance to that Aggravated damage or source.
vampire.disruption: Roll Resolve + Fortitude + explicit continuity protection when the attack permits a soak roll.
vampire.gunfire: Ordinary firearm damage is Non-Lethal/Bashing against a Vampire because puncturing dead organs is far less effective. Anti-materiel fire, vehicle-mounted weapons, explosive or incendiary ammunition, specialized anti-undead ammunition, and any attack explicitly labeled otherwise may deal Lethal or Aggravated damage.
vampire.halvingOrder: For Vampire Non-Lethal/Bashing damage, roll soak first, subtract soak successes, then halve the remaining damage and round down.

shapechanger.socialForm: Use the ordinary mortal rules: Resilience + Armor against Non-Lethal/Bashing, Armor only against Lethal, and no Aggravated soak.
shapechanger.huntingOrWarFormBashing: Roll Resilience + eligible Armor + Archetype Rating against Non-Lethal/Bashing damage.
shapechanger.huntingOrWarFormLethal: Roll Resilience + eligible Armor + Archetype Rating. Living Soak explicitly allows Resilience against Lethal damage while transformed.
shapechanger.aggravated: No soak roll from Resilience, Armor, Archetype Rating, or Living Soak. Apply only an exact ability that explicitly grants immunity or resistance to that Aggravated damage or source.
shapechanger.disruption: Use Resolve and explicit continuity protection. Living Soak does not apply.

soakByCharacter.otherArchetypes: Human Investigator, Eldritch Binder, Harmonic Mutant, and Technomancer use ordinary mortal or human-adjacent permissions unless a recorded power, form, item, or ability explicitly supplies supernatural soak.

sampleDamageDice.type: Lethal to living targets; normally Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires
Lethal to living targets; normally Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires
Lethal or Aggravated when explicitly rated

damageAndVitality.sharedTrack: Non-Lethal/Bashing, Lethal, Aggravated, and Disruption all remove current Vitality. Record each type separately because recovery and powers treat them differently.
damageAndVitality.noWoundedBand: At 1 or more Vitality, act normally unless a specific condition says otherwise. There is no universal Wounded state or penalty.
damageAndVitality.bashingAtZero: When Non-Lethal/Bashing damage reduces Vitality to 0, become Downed and Unstable. Excess Non-Lethal/Bashing does not immediately create Death Marks unless the attack explicitly states lethal intent. Further Non-Lethal/Bashing against a Downed target adds 1 Death Mark per 2 uncancelled damage, rounding down.
damageAndVitality.lethalAtZero: Every uncancelled Lethal, Aggravated, or Disruption damage success remaining after Vitality reaches 0 adds 1 Death Mark.
damageAndVitality.healing: Removing one recorded damage point restores one current Vitality. Ordinary first aid can treat Non-Lethal/Bashing and Lethal as allowed by its procedure. Aggravated damage requires a capability or treatment explicitly able to remove it.

exposure.meaning: Exposure is how open, predictable, or easy to target the character has become.
gain: After a Push resolves, gain 1 Exposure.
A hazard, capability, or Complication adds Exposure only when it explicitly says so.
exposure.combatEffect: Every Exposure point on a target adds one die to attacks against that target. Those extra attack dice can produce firearm critical successes. Exposure never adds damage dice directly.
exposure.limit: When Exposure reaches its Limit, finish the current action, suffer 1 Non-Lethal/Bashing damage that cannot be soaked, lose the current Reaction, and reset Exposure to 0.
recovery: Ten uninterrupted minutes free from combat, pursuit, and active hazards sets Exposure to 0.
A Full Rest sets Exposure to 0.

cohesion.meaning: Cohesion is deliberately spent to remain effective under immediate danger.

options.name: Commit
options.effect: Add two dice to that test.

options.name: Brace
options.effect: Cancel one remaining Non-Lethal/Bashing or Disruption damage success. Brace cannot cancel Lethal or Aggravated damage.

options.name: Anchor
options.timing: Reaction when an ally makes a Death Test or a test against involuntary control
options.effect: The ally rerolls up to two failed dice and keeps the new results.

options.name: Refuse Collapse
options.timing: Once per scene when damage would reduce positive Vitality to 0
options.effect: Remain at 1 Vitality and become Staggered until the end of the next turn. It cannot stop explicit instant death or be used while Downed.

pressureInCombat.rule: Pay Resource, mark printed Pressure, resolve the ability, then resolve a Crisis if Pressure reached its Limit.
pressureInCombat.persistence: Pressure remains after combat until the Archetype's printed recovery methods reduce it.
pressureInCombat.distinction: Exposure makes enemies more accurate. Pressure creates the Archetype's specific loss of control, mutation, hunger, instability, or overload.

downedDyingAndDeath.reachingZero: At 0 Vitality, become Downed and Unstable. Apply excess damage according to its type.
downedDyingAndDeath.gracePeriod: A character reduced to 0 makes no Death Test during that round. If still Unstable, the first Death Test occurs at the end of the following round.
downedDyingAndDeath.deathTest: Roll Resilience + Composure at difficulty 2 successes. Failure adds 1 Death Mark; a failed roll containing a 1 adds 2 instead.
downedDyingAndDeath.stabilize: Standard Action, adjacent target. Test Reason + Medicine at difficulty 2 with a field medical kit or 3 without one. Success makes the target Stable and removes 1 Death Mark.
downedDyingAndDeath.emergencyTreatment: Standard Action, adjacent Stable target at 0 Vitality, one field medical kit charge. Test Reason + Medicine at difficulty 3. Success removes one Non-Lethal/Bashing or Lethal damage, restores 1 Vitality, removes 1 Death Mark, ends Downed, and applies Staggered through the target's next turn.
downedDyingAndDeath.death: At 3 Death Marks the character is dead. Ordinary healing, Cohesion, Stabilize, Emergency Treatment, and retroactive declarations cannot reverse death.

legacyDamageTerms.Impact: Treat legacy references to Impact damage as Non-Lethal/Bashing damage.
legacyDamageTerms.Trauma: Treat legacy references to Trauma damage as Lethal damage unless the effect has been explicitly revised to Aggravated.
